Aaroniero_Arruruerie.en: Sorry, but I simply can't stand the sunlight, and the sunlight can't make it in here.

Askin_Nakk_Le_Vaar.en: My Schrift is "D" And my ability is "The Deathdealing". It allows me to perfectly calculate the "absolute lethal dose" of any substance I consume - the amount that will cause death without fail - and raise or lower that value as I see fit.

BG9.en: Even after your captain is defeated, you have the will to resist? I was hoping to recover some data before she perished completely, but if we must...

Cang_Du.en: Those who spend their lives together should remain together in death. That is my belief.

Chōjirō_Sasakibe.en: As a member of your school, I would only be able to imitate you. The role of a right-hand man should be to compensate for those areas which you cannot address!

Cirucci_Sanderwicci.en: Arrancar are warriors, and the Espada are their leaders. We are born to kill the enemy and win. There is no such thing as an acceptable loss!

Don_Kanonji.en: ...Run? Is that how you speak to a hero? How little you understand. Allow me to educate you. If a hero were to run from battle... the children could no longer call him a hero.

Dordoni_Alessandro_Del_Socaccio.en: Restraining yourself for the sake of battle, that's important for those who seek strength. I think it's a wonderful thing.

Ganju_Shiba.en: Sorry Aniki... I'll avenge your death next time. This time I blame my sister... because she didn't bring me up to be... a coward who runs away and leaves his friends behind!!

Gantenbainne_Mosqueda.en: There's no way the techniques of a Human who can't even use Sonído could ever reach me!

Gerard_Valkyrie.en: A woman’s slender arms cannot hope to halt a strike from my blade!

Giriko_Kutsuzawa.en: Truly, it is in impeccable timing that the divine can be found.

Gremmy_Thoumeaux.en: The most powerful force in this world is 'imagination.' Anything I imagine, anything at all, becomes reality.

Hachigen_Ushōda.en: What’s important is not 'how it should be,' but rather 'how you want it to be.

Ichibē_Hyōsube.en: You say my name so lightly... Don't blame me if you lose your voice.

Ichigo_Kurosaki.en: ... If fate is a millstone, then we are the grist. There is nothing we can do. So I wish for strength. If I cannot protect them from the wheel, then give me a strong blade, and enough strength... to shatter fate.

Izuru_Kira.en: A warrior should never plead for his own life.

Jidanbō_Ikkanzaka.en: Seems as if you are one of the uncivilized people. So disrespectful. I wasted my time waiting for you. You should be grateful!

Jugram_Haschwalth.en: His Majesty's will is all that matters. It is not my place to dispute his decision.

Kaien_Shiba.en: Remember that as long as you're in my division, I will stand by you even if I die.

Kaname_Tōsen.en: I already told you, Komamura. The path that harmonizes with my view is naught but the path that is least drenched in blood. There it is where justice always is. The very path that I tread upon is the one of justice.

Karin_Kurosaki.en: Whether you can see them or not, as long as you don't believe, it's the same as them not existing.

Kirio_Hikifune.en: When I prepare food, I pour all my Reiatsu into the cooking process... So once the meal is good and ready, I find myself a whole lot slimmer! That's why I have to fatten myself up the rest of the time - else my body couldn't stand it!

Kūgo_Ginjō.en: Time will try to constantly try to catch up with you. And with a roar, it will overcome you. Do not look ahead. Hope only lies within the unforeseeable current that will close in from behind.

Kūkaku_Shiba.en: This is my home. If you don't like the way I run this place, you can get the hell out!

Lille_Barro.en: It is the way of the world that those creatures which break away from the group are the first to die.

Marechiyo_Ōmaeda.en: Let me tell you something. You should never judge people on outer appearances.

Mashiro_Kuna.en: How dare you. You ruined my precious scarf! I'm not forgiving you now!!

Mask_De_Masculine.en: The cheers of my fans are all the strength I need!

Meninas_McAllon.en: Are you turning your back towards the enemy during battle? I feel insulted.

NaNaNa_Najahkoop.en: Sorry, man. I don't get any of this art stuff. But don't worry. You and that V-whatever of yours won't ever find the time to cry. 'Cause in five minutes' time, you're gonna be dead.

Nanao_Ise.en: What is wrong with you, Captain Kyōraku? That Ryoka is still alive. Shall I finish him off?

Nemu_Kurotsuchi.en: It would appear that you are making some kind of mistake. Attempting to use me as a hostage will achieve nothing.

PePe_Waccabrada.en: You have one heart! And you have one body! But one look into my eyes, and your heart is split in two! When heart and body join as one, they're mine for evermore!

Quilge_Opie.en: Each time I witness my victims struggling in vain the same thought occurs to me anew."Can the death of the weak truly be so wretched a sight?" It pains me to watch. Hurry and die.

Retsu_Unohana.en: While it is good to be energetic, please remain quiet inside the hospital. As long as you are still inside this building, your lives are in our hands. Please do not forget that.

Ryūken_Ishida.en: I have restored his Quincy powers. It is up to him whether they live or die. As well as whether he lives or dies.

Rōjūrō_Ōtoribashi.en: Come along. That's right... right this way. Slowly does it... closer and closer... until you are captive to my melody.

Shūkurō_Tsukishima.en: Why did you have to die? Why would you do that?! Why?!! Why would you do that, Ginjō?!! Ginjō, you taught me how to use my power. You taught me how to fight. So why, Ginjō. Why?! Why did you never teach me what I should do when you were gone?!

Szayelaporro_Granz.en: For inferior beings like you to irritate me to this extent and even force me to fight you at my full strength... Now, THAT is what I would call a 'bad joke'.

Tatsuki_Arisawa.en: I've seen you through so many hard times!! I've helped you so many times!! You don't...You don't hide things from someone like that.

Yammy_Llargo.en: I came here a few times with a mask on, but the Human World is more boring than I remember! The spiritual energy here is so thin, I think I'm going to suffocate!

Zommari_Rureaux.en: The reason for your defeat is that very pride which led you not to so much as give your name.

Äs_Nödt.en: Your Majesty... I'm scared. Am I going to die? Will I go to hell? Forgive me, Your Majesty. Don't be angry. I'm scared. I don't want any more pain. I'm scared of the pain. I'm scared, so scared, so scared, so scared, so scared, so scared, so afraid. So afr-

Ōetsu_Nimaiya.en: When you say you're lowering the lethal dose of my blood, that means if I have lots of blood in my body, I'll die, yeah? Then if I just let tons of that blood out 'til it's below the lethal dose, I'll be all good, right?
